name: scd-project-docs
description: Greenfield project kickoff workflow: produce the generic project-management documents once, at creation. Six user-invoked phases (kickoff, brief, prd, stack, adr, contract) drive a traceability chain Brief → PRD → Stack → foundational ADRs → CLAUDE.md. One-question-at-a-time interview for the upstream docs, justified options for the stack, immutable Nygard ADRs for the founding decisions. Per-feature specs (spec/plan/tasks) are OUT of scope — a separate workflow. Human decides the what; Claude drafts against templates and interviews to fill gaps.
